class Priv { private constructor() {} static make() { return new Priv(); } }
class Left { left = 1; }
class Right { right = 2; }
abstract class Abs { a = 1; }
class Two { constructor(public s: string) {} }
class Many { constructor(a: number); constructor(a: string); constructor(a: number | string) {} }
const flag = Boolean(1);
const a = new (flag ? Left : Abs)();
const b = new (flag ? Abs : Left)();
const c = new (flag ? Left : Priv)();
const d = new (flag ? Two : Two)(1);
const e = (flag ? Left : Right)();
const f = new (flag ? Many : Left)(true);
const g: Left = new (flag ? Left : Right)();
console.log(a, b, c, d, e, f, g);
